mapper.select: /* rta-queries-live.getPlayerRtaMatches rta_match JOIN 제거: battle_type 미사용, winner_position = p1(타겟 소환사).result. wizardId 중복 바인딩 방지: rms에 p1_wid 컬럼 포함, user_info 조인 시 rms.p1_wid 재사용. */ WITH rms AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT p0.replay_id AS rid, p0.played_at AS date_add, p0.wizard_id AS p1_wid FROM public.rta_match_participant p0 WHERE p0.wizard_id = #{wizardId} AND p0.season_id = #{seasonId} ORDER BY p0.played_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ), banned_pick AS ( SELECT ub.replay_id, ub.wizard_id, MIN(ub.unit_master_id::text) AS banned_unit FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick ub INNER JOIN rms ON rms.rid = ub.replay_id WHERE ub.is_banned = true GROUP BY ub.replay_id, ub.wizard_id ), user_info AS ( SELECT p.replay_id, p.wizard_id, p.wizard_id::text AS wizard_id_str, p.wizard_name, p.channel_uid, p.country_code AS country, CAST(p.ladder_score AS text) AS score, CAST(p.rating_id AS text) AS rating, CASE WHEN p.is_winner THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS result, CASE WHEN p.is_first_pick THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS first_pick, p.alive_count, p.leader_pick_slot, bp.banned_unit FROM public.rta_match_participant p INNER JOIN rms ON rms.rid = p.replay_id LEFT JOIN banned_pick bp ON bp.replay_id = p.replay_id AND bp.wizard_id = p.wizard_id ), unit_info AS ( SELECT u.replay_id, u.wizard_id, array_agg(u.unit_master_id::text ORDER BY u.pick_slot_no) AS picked_units, array_agg(u.is_banned ORDER BY u.pick_slot_no) AS unit_banned_flags, array_agg(u.pick_slot_no::int ORDER BY u.pick_slot_no) AS unit_pick_slot_nos, string_agg(u.unit_master_id::text, ',' ORDER BY u.pick_slot_no) AS picked_units_str FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u INNER JOIN rms ON rms.rid = u.replay_id GROUP BY u.replay_id, u.wizard_id ) SELECT rms.rid, rms.date_add, CASE WHEN u1.result = '1' THEN '1' ELSE '2' END AS winner_position, u1.wizard_id_str AS p1_wizard_id, u1.channel_uid AS p1_channel_uid, u1.wizard_name AS p1_name, u1.country AS p1_country, u1.score AS p1_score, u1.rating AS p1_rating, u1.result AS p1_result, u1.first_pick AS p1_first_pick, u1.alive_count AS p1_alive_count, u1.banned_unit AS p1_banned_unit, u1.leader_pick_slot AS p1_leader_unit, COALESCE(un1.picked_units, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p1_units, COALESCE(un1.unit_banned_flags, ARRAY[]::boolean[]) AS p1_unit_banned, COALESCE(un1.unit_pick_slot_nos, ARRAY[]::int[]) AS p1_unit_pick_slot_no, COALESCE(un1.picked_units_str, '') AS p1_units_str, u2.wizard_id_str AS p2_wizard_id, u2.channel_uid AS p2_channel_uid, u2.wizard_name AS p2_name, u2.country AS p2_country, u2.score AS p2_score, u2.rating AS p2_rating, u2.result AS p2_result, u2.first_pick AS p2_first_pick, u2.alive_count AS p2_alive_count, u2.banned_unit AS p2_banned_unit, u2.leader_pick_slot AS p2_leader_unit, COALESCE(un2.picked_units, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p2_units, COALESCE(un2.unit_banned_flags, ARRAY[]::boolean[]) AS p2_unit_banned, COALESCE(un2.unit_pick_slot_nos, ARRAY[]::int[]) AS p2_unit_pick_slot_no, COALESCE(un2.picked_units_str, '') AS p2_units_str FROM rms JOIN user_info u1 ON u1.replay_id = rms.rid AND u1.wizard_id = rms.p1_wid LEFT JOIN user_info u2 ON u2.replay_id = rms.rid AND u2.wizard_id != rms.p1_wid LEFT JOIN unit_info un1 ON un1.replay_id = rms.rid AND un1.wizard_id = rms.p1_wid LEFT JOIN unit_info un2 ON un2.replay_id = rms.rid AND un2.wizard_id != rms.p1_wid ORDER BY rms.date_add DESC NULLS LAST

WITH dedup AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (m.replay_id) m.replay_id AS rid, m.played_at AS date_add, m.battle_type, m.winner_wizard_id FROM public.rta_match m INNER JOIN public.rta_match_participant p0 ON p0.replay_id = m.replay_id AND p0.wizard_id = #{wizardId} AND p0.season_id = #{seasonId} INNER JOIN public.rta_match_participant p1 ON p1.replay_id = m.replay_id AND p1.wizard_id = #{opponentWizardId}
ORDER BY m.replay_id, m.played_at DESC NULLS LAST ), rms AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT rid, date_add, battle_type, winner_wizard_id FROM dedup ORDER BY date_add DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ), banned_pick AS ( SELECT ub.replay_id, ub.wizard_id, MIN(ub.unit_master_id::text) AS banned_unit FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick ub INNER JOIN rms ON rms.rid = ub.replay_id WHERE ub.is_banned = true GROUP BY ub.replay_id, ub.wizard_id ), user_info AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.replay_id, p.wizard_id) p.replay_id, p.wizard_id, p.wizard_id::text AS wizard_id_str, p.wizard_name, p.channel_uid, p.country_code AS country, CAST(p.ladder_score AS text) AS score, CAST(p.rating_id AS text) AS rating, CASE WHEN p.is_winner THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS result, CASE WHEN p.is_first_pick THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS first_pick, p.alive_count, p.leader_pick_slot, bp.banned_unit FROM public.rta_match_participant p INNER JOIN rms ON rms.rid = p.replay_id LEFT JOIN banned_pick bp ON bp.replay_id = p.replay_id AND bp.wizard_id = p.wizard_id ORDER BY p.replay_id, p.wizard_id ), unit_info AS ( SELECT u.replay_id, u.wizard_id, array_agg(u.unit_master_id::text ORDER BY u.pick_slot_no) AS picked_units, array_agg(u.is_banned ORDER BY u.pick_slot_no) AS unit_banned_flags, array_agg(u.pick_slot_no::int ORDER BY u.pick_slot_no) AS unit_pick_slot_nos, string_agg(u.unit_master_id::text, ',' ORDER BY u.pick_slot_no) AS picked_units_str FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u INNER JOIN rms ON rms.rid = u.replay_id GROUP BY u.replay_id, u.wizard_id ), pair AS ( SELECT rms.rid, MIN(ui.wizard_id) AS p1w, MAX(ui.wizard_id) AS p2w FROM rms JOIN user_info ui ON ui.replay_id = rms.rid GROUP BY rms.rid ) SELECT rms.rid, rms.battle_type, rms.date_add, CASE WHEN rms.winner_wizard_id = pr.p1w THEN '1' ELSE '2' END AS winner_position, u1.wizard_id_str AS p1_wizard_id, u1.channel_uid AS p1_channel_uid, u1.wizard_name AS p1_name, u1.country AS p1_country, u1.score AS p1_score, u1.rating AS p1_rating, u1.result AS p1_result, u1.first_pick AS p1_first_pick, u1.alive_count AS p1_alive_count, u1.banned_unit AS p1_banned_unit, u1.leader_pick_slot AS p1_leader_unit, COALESCE(un1.picked_units, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p1_units, COALESCE(un1.unit_banned_flags, ARRAY[]::boolean[]) AS p1_unit_banned, COALESCE(un1.unit_pick_slot_nos, ARRAY[]::int[]) AS p1_unit_pick_slot_no, COALESCE(un1.picked_units_str, '') AS p1_units_str, u2.wizard_id_str AS p2_wizard_id, u2.channel_uid AS p2_channel_uid, u2.wizard_name AS p2_name, u2.country AS p2_country, u2.score AS p2_score, u2.rating AS p2_rating, u2.result AS p2_result, u2.first_pick AS p2_first_pick, u2.alive_count AS p2_alive_count, u2.banned_unit AS p2_banned_unit, u2.leader_pick_slot AS p2_leader_unit, COALESCE(un2.picked_units, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p2_units, COALESCE(un2.unit_banned_flags, ARRAY[]::boolean[]) AS p2_unit_banned, COALESCE(un2.unit_pick_slot_nos, ARRAY[]::int[]) AS p2_unit_pick_slot_no, COALESCE(un2.picked_units_str, '') AS p2_units_str FROM rms JOIN pair pr ON pr.rid = rms.rid JOIN user_info u1 ON u1.replay_id = rms.rid AND u1.wizard_id = pr.p1w JOIN user_info u2 ON u2.replay_id = rms.rid AND u2.wizard_id = pr.p2w LEFT JOIN unit_info un1 ON un1.replay_id = rms.rid AND un1.wizard_id = u1.wizard_id LEFT JOIN unit_info un2 ON un2.replay_id = rms.rid AND un2.wizard_id = u2.wizard_id ORDER BY rms.date_add DESC NULLS LAST

WITH rms AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT m.replay_id AS rid, m.played_at AS date_add, m.battle_type, m.winner_wizard_id FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u INNER JOIN public.rta_match m ON m.replay_id = u.replay_id AND m.season_id = #{seasonId} WHERE u.unit_master_id = #{monsterId}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.rta_match_participant p WHERE p.replay_id = m.replay_id AND p.rating_id = #{ratingId} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.rta_match_participant p WHERE p.replay_id = m.replay_id AND p.rating_id IN #{rid} )
GROUP BY m.replay_id, m.played_at, m.battle_type, m.winner_wizard_id ORDER BY m.played_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT #{limit} ), rms_paged AS (SELECT * FROM rms), banned_pick AS ( SELECT ub.replay_id, ub.wizard_id, MIN(ub.unit_master_id::text) AS banned_unit FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick ub INNER JOIN rms_paged ON rms_paged.rid = ub.replay_id WHERE ub.is_banned = true GROUP BY ub.replay_id, ub.wizard_id ), user_info AS ( SELECT p.replay_id, p.wizard_id, p.wizard_name, p.channel_uid, p.country_code AS country, CAST(p.ladder_score AS text) AS score, CAST(p.rating_id AS text) AS rating, CASE WHEN p.is_winner THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS result, CASE WHEN p.is_first_pick THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS first_pick, p.alive_count, p.leader_pick_slot, bp.banned_unit FROM public.rta_match_participant p INNER JOIN rms_paged ON rms_paged.rid = p.replay_id LEFT JOIN banned_pick bp ON bp.replay_id = p.replay_id AND bp.wizard_id = p.wizard_id ), unit_info AS ( SELECT u.replay_id, u.wizard_id, array_agg(u.unit_master_id::text ORDER BY u.pick_slot_no) AS picked_units, array_agg(u.is_banned ORDER BY u.pick_slot_no) AS unit_banned_flags, array_agg(u.pick_slot_no::int ORDER BY u.pick_slot_no) AS unit_pick_slot_nos, string_agg(u.unit_master_id::text, ',' ORDER BY u.pick_slot_no) AS picked_units_str FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u INNER JOIN rms_paged ON rms_paged.rid = u.replay_id GROUP BY u.replay_id, u.wizard_id ), pair AS ( SELECT rms_paged.rid, MIN(ui.wizard_id) AS p1w, MAX(ui.wizard_id) AS p2w FROM rms_paged JOIN user_info ui ON ui.replay_id = rms_paged.rid GROUP BY rms_paged.rid ) SELECT rms_paged.rid, rms_paged.battle_type, rms_paged.date_add, CASE WHEN rms_paged.winner_wizard_id = pr.p1w THEN '1' ELSE '2' END AS winner_position, u1.wizard_id AS p1_wizard_id, u1.channel_uid AS p1_channel_uid, u1.wizard_name AS p1_name, u1.country AS p1_country, u1.score AS p1_score, u1.rating AS p1_rating, u1.result AS p1_result, u1.first_pick AS p1_first_pick, u1.alive_count AS p1_alive_count, u1.banned_unit AS p1_banned_unit, u1.leader_pick_slot AS p1_leader_unit, COALESCE(un1.picked_units, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p1_units, COALESCE(un1.unit_banned_flags, ARRAY[]::boolean[]) AS p1_unit_banned, COALESCE(un1.unit_pick_slot_nos, ARRAY[]::int[]) AS p1_unit_pick_slot_no, COALESCE(un1.picked_units_str, '') AS p1_units_str, u2.wizard_id AS p2_wizard_id, u2.channel_uid AS p2_channel_uid, u2.wizard_name AS p2_name, u2.country AS p2_country, u2.score AS p2_score, u2.rating AS p2_rating, u2.result AS p2_result, u2.first_pick AS p2_first_pick, u2.alive_count AS p2_alive_count, u2.banned_unit AS p2_banned_unit, u2.leader_pick_slot AS p2_leader_unit, COALESCE(un2.picked_units, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p2_units, COALESCE(un2.unit_banned_flags, ARRAY[]::boolean[]) AS p2_unit_banned, COALESCE(un2.unit_pick_slot_nos, ARRAY[]::int[]) AS p2_unit_pick_slot_no, COALESCE(un2.picked_units_str, '') AS p2_units_str FROM rms_paged JOIN pair pr ON pr.rid = rms_paged.rid JOIN user_info u1 ON u1.replay_id = rms_paged.rid AND u1.wizard_id = pr.p1w JOIN user_info u2 ON u2.replay_id = rms_paged.rid AND u2.wizard_id = pr.p2w LEFT JOIN unit_info un1 ON un1.replay_id = rms_paged.rid AND un1.wizard_id = u1.wizard_id LEFT JOIN unit_info un2 ON un2.replay_id = rms_paged.rid AND un2.wizard_id = u2.wizard_id ORDER BY rms_paged.date_add DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM public.rta_match m WHERE m.played_at >= DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_matches, COUNT(DISTINCT r.replay_id) as unique_matches, COUNT(DISTINCT u.wizard_id) as unique_users, COUNT(DISTINCT unit.unit_master_id) as unique_units FROM public.rta_match r LEFT JOIN public.rta_match_participant u ON r.replay_id = u.replay_id LEFT JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick unit ON r.replay_id = unit.replay_id LIMIT 1

SELECT r.replay_id AS rid, r.battle_type, r.played_at AS date_add, COUNT(DISTINCT u.wizard_id) as player_count, COUNT(DISTINCT unit.unit_master_id) as unit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT unit.wizard_id) as pick_count FROM public.rta_match r LEFT JOIN public.rta_match_participant u ON r.replay_id = u.replay_id LEFT JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick unit ON r.replay_id = unit.replay_id GROUP BY r.replay_id, r.battle_type, r.played_at ORDER BY r.played_at DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT 'rta_match_participant' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM public.rta_match_participant WHERE replay_id = #{rid} UNION ALL SELECT 'rta_match_unit_pick' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick WHERE replay_id = #{rid}

WITH deleted AS ( DELETE FROM public.rta_agg_tier_daily WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} ) INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_tier_daily (season_id, bucket_date, grade_slot, player_count, sort_order, computed_at) SELECT #{seasonId}, d.bucket_date, d.grade_slot, d.player_count, d.sort_order, now() FROM (
) d ON CONFLICT (season_id, bucket_date, grade_slot) DO UPDATE SET player_count = EXCLUDED.player_count, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, computed_at = EXCLUDED.computed_at
mapper.select: WITH match_total AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.total_matches), 0) AS total_matches FROM public.rta_agg_season_rating_match_total t WHERE t.season_id = #{seasonId} ) SELECT s.combo_unit_key AS monster_id, m.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental, m.kr_name AS monster_name, AS monster_image, s.pick_cnt AS pick_count, ROUND((s.pick_cnt::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT mt.total_matches FROM match_total mt), 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS pick_rate, CASE WHEN s.match_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND((s.win_cnt::numeric / s.match_cnt * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END AS win_rate, CASE WHEN s.pick_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(s.ban_cnt, 0)::numeric / s.pick_cnt * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END AS ban_rate FROM public.rta_agg_monster_stats_tier_top_snap s INNER JOIN public.monster m ON m.monster_id = s.combo_unit_key WHERE s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND s.stat_kind = 'S' AND s.pick_cnt >= #{minPickCount} AND m.kr_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.rank_position LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 1) AS monster_id_1, split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 2) AS monster_id_2, m1.kr_name AS monster_name_1, m2.kr_name AS monster_name_2, AS monster_image_1, AS monster_image_2, m1.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_1, m2.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_2, s.match_cnt AS match_count, ROUND((s.win_cnt::numeric / NULLIF(s.match_cnt, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS win_rate FROM public.rta_agg_monster_stats_tier_top_snap s INNER JOIN public.monster m1 ON m1.monster_id = split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 1) INNER JOIN public.monster m2 ON m2.monster_id = split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 2) WHERE s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND s.stat_kind = 'D' AND s.match_cnt >= #{minPickCount} AND m1.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m2.kr_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.rank_position LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 1) AS monster_id_1, split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 2) AS monster_id_2, split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 3) AS monster_id_3, m1.kr_name AS monster_name_1, m2.kr_name AS monster_name_2, m3.kr_name AS monster_name_3, AS monster_image_1, AS monster_image_2, AS monster_image_3, m1.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_1, m2.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_2, m3.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_3, s.match_cnt AS match_count, ROUND((s.win_cnt::numeric / NULLIF(s.match_cnt, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS win_rate FROM public.rta_agg_monster_stats_tier_top_snap s INNER JOIN public.monster m1 ON m1.monster_id = split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 1) INNER JOIN public.monster m2 ON m2.monster_id = split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 2) INNER JOIN public.monster m3 ON m3.monster_id = split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 3) WHERE s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND s.stat_kind = 'T' AND s.match_cnt >= #{minPickCount} AND m1.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m2.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m3.kr_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.rank_position LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

/* RtaMapper.getDashboardPreviewSoloFromSnap */ SELECT t.monster_id, t.monster_elemental, t.monster_name, t.monster_image, t.pick_count, t.win_rate, t.ban_rate FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.combo_unit_key) s.combo_unit_key AS monster_id, m.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental, m.kr_name AS monster_name, AS monster_image, s.pick_cnt AS pick_count, CASE WHEN s.match_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND((s.win_cnt::numeric / s.match_cnt * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END AS win_rate, CASE WHEN s.pick_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(s.ban_cnt, 0)::numeric / s.pick_cnt * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END AS ban_rate FROM public.rta_agg_monster_stats_tier_top_snap s INNER JOIN public.monster m ON m.monster_id = s.combo_unit_key WHERE s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND s.stat_kind = 'S' AND s.pick_cnt >= #{minPickCount} AND m.kr_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.combo_unit_key, s.pick_cnt DESC ) t ORDER BY t.pick_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

/* RtaMapper.getDashboardPreviewDuoFromSnap */ SELECT t.monster_id_1, t.monster_id_2, t.monster_name_1, t.monster_name_2, t.monster_image_1, t.monster_image_2, t.monster_elemental_1, t.monster_elemental_2, t.match_count, t.win_rate FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.combo_unit_key) split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 1) AS monster_id_1, split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 2) AS monster_id_2, m1.kr_name AS monster_name_1, m2.kr_name AS monster_name_2, AS monster_image_1, AS monster_image_2, m1.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_1, m2.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_2, s.match_cnt AS match_count, ROUND((s.win_cnt::numeric / NULLIF(s.match_cnt, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS win_rate FROM public.rta_agg_monster_stats_tier_top_snap s INNER JOIN public.monster m1 ON m1.monster_id = split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 1) INNER JOIN public.monster m2 ON m2.monster_id = split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 2) WHERE s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND s.stat_kind = 'D' AND s.match_cnt >= #{minPickCount} AND m1.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m2.kr_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.combo_unit_key, s.match_cnt DESC ) t ORDER BY t.match_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

/* RtaMapper.getDashboardPreviewTrioFromSnap */ SELECT t.monster_id_1, t.monster_id_2, t.monster_id_3, t.monster_name_1, t.monster_name_2, t.monster_name_3, t.monster_image_1, t.monster_image_2, t.monster_image_3, t.monster_elemental_1, t.monster_elemental_2, t.monster_elemental_3, t.match_count, t.win_rate FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.combo_unit_key) split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 1) AS monster_id_1, split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 2) AS monster_id_2, split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 3) AS monster_id_3, m1.kr_name AS monster_name_1, m2.kr_name AS monster_name_2, m3.kr_name AS monster_name_3, AS monster_image_1, AS monster_image_2, AS monster_image_3, m1.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_1, m2.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_2, m3.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_3, s.match_cnt AS match_count, ROUND((s.win_cnt::numeric / NULLIF(s.match_cnt, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS win_rate FROM public.rta_agg_monster_stats_tier_top_snap s INNER JOIN public.monster m1 ON m1.monster_id = split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 1) INNER JOIN public.monster m2 ON m2.monster_id = split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 2) INNER JOIN public.monster m3 ON m3.monster_id = split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 3) WHERE s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND s.stat_kind = 'T' AND s.match_cnt >= #{minPickCount} AND m1.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m2.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m3.kr_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.combo_unit_key, s.match_cnt DESC ) t ORDER BY t.match_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH pick_stats AS ( SELECT u.unit_master_id, m.monster_elemental as monster_elemental, m.kr_name as monster_name, as monster_image, COUNT(*) AS pick_count FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u INNER JOIN public.rta_match_participant p ON u.replay_id = p.replay_id AND u.wizard_id = p.wizard_id LEFT JOIN public.monster m ON m.monster_id = u.unit_master_id::text WHERE m.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND u.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} AND p.season_id = #{seasonId} GROUP BY u.unit_master_id, m.monster_elemental, m.kr_name, m.image_url ), win_stats AS ( SELECT u.unit_master_id, COUNT(*) AS win_count FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u JOIN public.rta_match_participant ul ON u.replay_id = ul.replay_id AND u.wizard_id = ul.wizard_id WHERE ul.is_winner IS TRUE AND NOT u.is_banned AND u.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} AND ul.season_id = #{seasonId} GROUP BY u.unit_master_id ), ban_stats AS ( SELECT u.unit_master_id, COUNT(*) as ban_count FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u INNER JOIN public.rta_match_participant p ON u.replay_id = p.replay_id AND u.wizard_id = p.wizard_id WHERE u.is_banned = true AND u.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} AND p.season_id = #{seasonId} GROUP BY u.unit_master_id ) SELECT ps.unit_master_id as monster_id, ps.monster_elemental, ps.monster_name, ps.monster_image, ps.pick_count, ROUND((ps.pick_count::numeric / NULLIF(mc.total_matches, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) as pick_rate, /* 승률 = WinCount / (PickCount − BanCount) — 실경기 투입만 분모. 분모 0 이면 NULL */ CASE WHEN (ps.pick_count - COALESCE(bs.ban_count, 0)) > 0 THEN ROUND( (COALESCE(ws.win_count, 0)::numeric / (ps.pick_count - COALESCE(bs.ban_count, 0))::numeric * 100)::numeric, 2 ) ELSE NULL END as win_rate, CASE WHEN ps.pick_count > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(bs.ban_count, 0)::numeric / ps.pick_count * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as ban_rate FROM pick_stats ps CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.total_matches), 0) AS total_matches FROM public.rta_agg_season_rating_match_total t WHERE t.season_id = #{seasonId} ) mc LEFT JOIN win_stats ws ON ps.unit_master_id = ws.unit_master_id LEFT JOIN ban_stats bs ON ps.unit_master_id = bs.unit_master_id LIMIT 1

WITH , my_matches AS ( SELECT DISTINCT u1.replay_id, u1.wizard_id FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u1 INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r0 ON u1.replay_id = r0.rid WHERE u1.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} ), opponent_stats AS ( SELECT u2.unit_master_id as opponent_monster_id, m.monster_elemental as opponent_monster_elemental, m.kr_name as opponent_monster_name, as opponent_monster_image, COUNT(*) as match_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ul1.is_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as win_count FROM my_matches mm JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick u2 ON mm.replay_id = u2.replay_id JOIN public.rta_match_participant ul1 ON mm.replay_id = ul1.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = ul1.wizard_id JOIN public.rta_match_participant ul2 ON mm.replay_id = ul2.replay_id AND u2.wizard_id = ul2.wizard_id AND ul1.wizard_id != ul2.wizard_id JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON mm.replay_id = r.rid LEFT JOIN public.monster m ON m.monster_id = u2.unit_master_id::text WHERE u2.unit_master_id != #{monsterId} AND m.kr_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u2.unit_master_id, m.monster_elemental, m.kr_name, m.image_url HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ) SELECT opponent_monster_id as monster_id, opponent_monster_elemental as monster_elemental, opponent_monster_name as monster_name, opponent_monster_image as monster_image, CASE WHEN match_count > 0 THEN ROUND((win_count::numeric / match_count * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as win_rate, match_count FROM opponent_stats ORDER BY match_count DESC, win_rate DESC LIMIT 20

WITH , my_matches AS ( SELECT DISTINCT u1.replay_id, u1.wizard_id FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u1 INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r0 ON u1.replay_id = r0.rid WHERE u1.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} ), combo_stats AS ( SELECT u2.unit_master_id as combo_monster_id, m.monster_elemental as combo_monster_elemental, m.kr_name as combo_monster_name, as combo_monster_image, COUNT(*) as match_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ul.is_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as win_count FROM my_matches mm JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick u2 ON mm.replay_id = u2.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = u2.wizard_id JOIN public.rta_match_participant ul ON mm.replay_id = ul.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = ul.wizard_id JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON mm.replay_id = r.rid LEFT JOIN public.monster m ON m.monster_id = u2.unit_master_id::text WHERE u2.unit_master_id != #{monsterId} AND m.kr_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u2.unit_master_id, m.monster_elemental, m.kr_name, m.image_url HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ) SELECT combo_monster_id as monster_id, combo_monster_elemental as monster_elemental, combo_monster_name as monster_name, combo_monster_image as monster_image, CASE WHEN match_count > 0 THEN ROUND((win_count::numeric / match_count * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as win_rate, match_count FROM combo_stats ORDER BY match_count DESC, win_rate DESC LIMIT 20

WITH , my_matches AS ( -- 내가 사용한 매치들 SELECT DISTINCT u1.replay_id, u1.wizard_id FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u1 INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r0 ON u1.replay_id = r0.rid WHERE u1.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} ), triple_combo_stats AS ( SELECT u2.unit_master_id as monster1_id, m1.monster_elemental as monster1_elemental, m1.kr_name as monster1_name, as monster1_image, u3.unit_master_id as monster2_id, m2.monster_elemental as monster2_elemental, m2.kr_name as monster2_name, as monster2_image, COUNT(*) as match_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ul.is_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as win_count FROM my_matches mm JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick u2 ON mm.replay_id = u2.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = u2.wizard_id JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick u3 ON mm.replay_id = u3.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = u3.wizard_id JOIN public.rta_match_participant ul ON mm.replay_id = ul.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = ul.wizard_id JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON mm.replay_id = r.rid LEFT JOIN public.monster m1 ON m1.monster_id = u2.unit_master_id::text LEFT JOIN public.monster m2 ON m2.monster_id = u3.unit_master_id::text WHERE u2.unit_master_id != #{monsterId} AND u3.unit_master_id != #{monsterId} AND u2.unit_master_id < u3.unit_master_id AND m1.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m2.kr_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u2.unit_master_id, m1.monster_elemental, m1.kr_name, m1.image_url, u3.unit_master_id, m2.monster_elemental, m2.kr_name, m2.image_url HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ) SELECT monster1_id, monster1_elemental, monster1_name, monster1_image, monster2_id, monster2_elemental, monster2_name, monster2_image, CASE WHEN match_count > 0 THEN ROUND((win_count::numeric / match_count * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as win_rate, match_count FROM triple_combo_stats ORDER BY match_count DESC, win_rate DESC LIMIT 20

WITH , my_matches AS ( SELECT DISTINCT u1.replay_id, u1.wizard_id, r.date_add FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u1 INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON u1.replay_id = r.rid WHERE u1.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} ORDER BY r.date_add DESC LIMIT 20 ), my_team_json AS ( SELECT mm.replay_id, mm.wizard_id, json_agg( json_build_object( 'monster_id', u1.unit_master_id, 'monster_name', COALESCE(m1.kr_name, ''), 'monster_image', COALESCE(, '') ) ORDER BY u1.pick_slot_no ) as my_team FROM my_matches mm JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick u1 ON mm.replay_id = u1.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = u1.wizard_id LEFT JOIN public.monster m1 ON m1.monster_id = u1.unit_master_id::text GROUP BY mm.replay_id, mm.wizard_id ), opponent_team_json AS ( SELECT mm.replay_id, json_agg( json_build_object( 'monster_id', u2.unit_master_id, 'monster_name', COALESCE(m2.kr_name, ''), 'monster_image', COALESCE(, '') ) ORDER BY u2.pick_slot_no ) as opponent_team FROM my_matches mm JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick u2 ON mm.replay_id = u2.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id != u2.wizard_id LEFT JOIN public.monster m2 ON m2.monster_id = u2.unit_master_id::text GROUP BY mm.replay_id ) SELECT mm.replay_id as match_id, mm.date_add as match_date, CASE WHEN ul.is_winner THEN 'WIN' ELSE 'LOSE' END as win_lose, COALESCE(mt.my_team::text, '[]') as my_team, COALESCE(ot.opponent_team::text, '[]') as opponent_team FROM my_matches mm JOIN public.rta_match_participant ul ON mm.replay_id = ul.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = ul.wizard_id JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON mm.replay_id = r.rid LEFT JOIN my_team_json mt ON mm.replay_id = mt.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = mt.wizard_id LEFT JOIN opponent_team_json ot ON mm.replay_id = ot.replay_id ORDER BY mm.date_add DESC

SELECT a.bucket_date, a.grade_slot AS "gradeSlot", rg.rating_id AS "ratingId", a.player_count, a.sort_order FROM public.rta_agg_tier_daily a LEFT JOIN public.rta_rating_grade rg ON rg.grade_slot = a.grade_slot WHERE a.season_id = #{seasonId} ORDER BY a.bucket_date, a.sort_order
ORDER BY bucket_date, sort_order

/* rta-queries-live.getRtaPlayerSummaryFromAgg search_snap: 닉·국가·채널 PK 조회 — latest participant 풀스캔·Sort 제거. score_profile: idx_rta_participant_ranking_v2(ladder_score DESC, replay_id DESC) 1행. last_at: idx_rta_participant_player_timeline(played_at DESC, replay_id DESC) 1행. match_cnt·win_cnt: fight_snap PK 우선, 없을 때만 participant 집계. */ WITH search AS ( SELECT wizard_name, country, channel_uid FROM public.rta_agg_summoner_search_snap WHERE wizard_id = #{wizardId} LIMIT 1 ), score_profile AS ( SELECT p.ladder_score::int AS score, p.rating_id, p.ladder_rank, p.wizard_name AS sp_wizard_name, p.country_code AS sp_country, p.channel_uid AS sp_channel_uid FROM public.rta_match_participant p WHERE p.season_id = #{seasonId} AND p.wizard_id = #{wizardId} AND p.ladder_score > 0 ORDER BY p.ladder_score DESC NULLS LAST, p.replay_id DESC LIMIT 1 ), last_at AS ( SELECT p.played_at AS last_match_at FROM public.rta_match_participant p WHERE p.season_id = #{seasonId} AND p.wizard_id = #{wizardId} ORDER BY p.played_at DESC NULLS LAST, p.replay_id DESC LIMIT 1 ), fight_snap AS ( SELECT match_cnt, win_cnt FROM public.rta_agg_summoner_season_fight_snap WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} AND wizard_id = #{wizardId} ), live_agg AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mp.is_winner) AS win_cnt FROM public.rta_match_participant mp WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fight_snap) AND mp.season_id = #{seasonId} AND mp.wizard_id = #{wizardId} ), profile AS ( SELECT #{wizardId}::text AS wizard_id, COALESCE(sr.wizard_name, sp.sp_wizard_name) AS wizard_name, COALESCE(sr.country, sp.sp_country) AS country, COALESCE(sr.channel_uid, sp.sp_channel_uid) AS channel_uid, sp.score, sp.rating_id, sp.ladder_rank, la.last_match_at FROM search sr LEFT JOIN score_profile sp ON TRUE LEFT JOIN last_at la ON TRUE WHERE sr.wizard_name IS NOT NULL OR sp.score IS NOT NULL OR la.last_match_at IS NOT NULL ) SELECT COALESCE(s.rank_position, p.ladder_rank) AS rank_position, p.wizard_id, p.wizard_name, p.country, p.channel_uid, COALESCE(s.score, p.score) AS score, COALESCE(s.rating_id, p.rating_id) AS rating_id, p.last_match_at, COALESCE(fs.match_cnt, la.match_cnt, 0) AS match_count, COALESCE(fs.win_cnt, la.win_cnt, 0) AS win_count, COALESCE(s.max_season_score::int, p.score::int) AS max_season_score, CASE WHEN COALESCE(fs.match_cnt, la.match_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND( 100.0 * COALESCE(fs.win_cnt, la.win_cnt, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(COALESCE(fs.match_cnt, la.match_cnt), 0)::numeric, 1 ) ELSE NULL END AS win_rate_pct FROM profile p LEFT JOIN fight_snap fs ON TRUE LEFT JOIN live_agg la ON TRUE LEFT JOIN public.rta_agg_summoner_ranking_snap s ON s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND s.wizard_id = p.wizard_id LIMIT 1

/* rta-queries-live.getRtaPlayerSummarySnapFirst page-data·초기 로드: search·ranking·fight·score_daily 스냅 우선. participant는 랭킹·일별점수 스냅 모두 없을 때 score 1회, 마지막 경기 시각은 일별 스냅 없을 때만 1회. */ WITH search AS ( SELECT wizard_name, country, channel_uid FROM public.rta_agg_summoner_search_snap WHERE wizard_id = #{wizardId} LIMIT 1 ), ranking AS ( SELECT rank_position, score, rating_id, max_season_score, wizard_name AS rk_wizard_name, country AS rk_country, channel_uid AS rk_channel_uid FROM public.rta_agg_summoner_ranking_snap WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} AND wizard_id = #{wizardId} LIMIT 1 ), fight_snap AS ( SELECT match_cnt, win_cnt, non_ban_pick_cnt, ban_event_cnt, computed_at, CASE WHEN match_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * win_cnt::numeric / match_cnt::numeric, 2) END AS season_win_rate_pct FROM public.rta_agg_summoner_season_fight_snap WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} AND wizard_id = #{wizardId} LIMIT 1 ), score_daily_tail AS ( SELECT d.end_of_day_score AS latest_score, d.snap_date AS latest_snap_date FROM public.rta_agg_summoner_score_daily_snap d WHERE d.season_id = #{seasonId} AND d.wizard_id = #{wizardId} ORDER BY d.snap_date DESC LIMIT 1 ), score_daily_max AS ( SELECT MAX(d.end_of_day_score)::int AS max_score FROM public.rta_agg_summoner_score_daily_snap d WHERE d.season_id = #{seasonId} AND d.wizard_id = #{wizardId} ), need_participant_score AS ( SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ranking) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM score_daily_tail t WHERE t.latest_score IS NOT NULL AND t.latest_score > 0 ) ), part_score AS ( SELECT p.ladder_score::int AS score, p.rating_id, p.ladder_rank, p.wizard_name, p.country_code AS country, p.channel_uid FROM public.rta_match_participant p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM need_participant_score) AND p.season_id = #{seasonId} AND p.wizard_id = #{wizardId} AND p.ladder_score > 0 ORDER BY p.ladder_score DESC NULLS LAST, p.replay_id DESC LIMIT 1 ), part_last AS ( SELECT p.played_at AS last_match_at FROM public.rta_match_participant p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM score_daily_tail) AND p.season_id = #{seasonId} AND p.wizard_id = #{wizardId} ORDER BY p.played_at DESC NULLS LAST, p.replay_id DESC LIMIT 1 ), profile AS ( SELECT #{wizardId}::text AS wizard_id, COALESCE(sr.wizard_name, rk.rk_wizard_name, ps.wizard_name) AS wizard_name, COALESCE(sr.country, rk.rk_country, ps.country) AS country, COALESCE(sr.channel_uid, rk.rk_channel_uid, ps.channel_uid) AS channel_uid, COALESCE(rk.score, sdt.latest_score, ps.score) AS score, COALESCE(rk.rating_id, ps.rating_id) AS rating_id, COALESCE(rk.rank_position, ps.ladder_rank) AS rank_position, COALESCE(rk.max_season_score::int, sdm.max_score, COALESCE(rk.score, sdt.latest_score, ps.score)::int) AS max_season_score, COALESCE(pl.last_match_at::text, sdt.latest_snap_date::text) AS last_match_at, fs.match_cnt AS fs_match_cnt, fs.win_cnt AS fs_win_cnt, fs.non_ban_pick_cnt AS fs_non_ban_pick_cnt, fs.ban_event_cnt AS fs_ban_event_cnt, fs.computed_at AS fs_computed_at, fs.season_win_rate_pct AS fs_season_win_rate_pct FROM (SELECT 1) anchor LEFT JOIN search sr ON TRUE LEFT JOIN ranking rk ON TRUE LEFT JOIN fight_snap fs ON TRUE LEFT JOIN score_daily_tail sdt ON TRUE LEFT JOIN score_daily_max sdm ON TRUE LEFT JOIN part_score ps ON TRUE LEFT JOIN part_last pl ON TRUE WHERE sr.wizard_name IS NOT NULL OR rk.score IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(fs.match_cnt, 0) > 0 OR sdt.latest_score IS NOT NULL OR ps.score IS NOT NULL OR pl.last_match_at IS NOT NULL ) SELECT p.rank_position, p.wizard_id, p.wizard_name, p.country, p.channel_uid, p.score, p.rating_id, p.last_match_at, COALESCE(p.fs_match_cnt, 0) AS match_count, COALESCE(p.fs_win_cnt, 0) AS win_count, p.max_season_score, CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.fs_match_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND( 100.0 * COALESCE(p.fs_win_cnt, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(p.fs_match_cnt, 0)::numeric, 1 ) ELSE NULL END AS win_rate_pct, p.fs_match_cnt, p.fs_non_ban_pick_cnt, p.fs_ban_event_cnt, p.fs_computed_at, p.fs_season_win_rate_pct FROM profile p LIMIT 1

/* rta-queries-live.getRtaPlayerSeasonFightSnapPkOnly — page-data 초기 로드용, 라이브 폴백 없음 */ SELECT s.match_cnt AS match_cnt, s.non_ban_pick_cnt AS non_ban_pick_cnt, s.ban_event_cnt AS ban_event_cnt, CASE WHEN s.match_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * s.win_cnt::numeric / s.match_cnt::numeric, 2) END AS season_win_rate_pct, s.computed_at FROM public.rta_agg_summoner_season_fight_snap s WHERE s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND s.wizard_id = #{wizardId} LIMIT 1

/* rta-queries-live.getRtaPlayerSeasonFightSnapFromAgg snap(rta_agg_summoner_season_fight_snap)에 match_cnt·win_cnt·non_ban_pick_cnt·ban_event_cnt 모두 있음. snap 행이 존재하면 live 스캔 없이 snap 값만 사용한다. snap 행이 없을 때만 rta_match_participant + rta_match_unit_pick 폴백. */ WITH snap AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT match_cnt, win_cnt, non_ban_pick_cnt, ban_event_cnt, computed_at FROM public.rta_agg_summoner_season_fight_snap WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} AND wizard_id = #{wizardId} LIMIT 1 ), live_part AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mp.replay_id) AS match_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mp.is_winner IS TRUE THEN mp.replay_id END) AS win_cnt FROM public.rta_match_participant mp WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM snap) AND mp.season_id = #{seasonId} AND mp.wizard_id = #{wizardId} ), live_picks AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT up.is_banned THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS non_ban_pick_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN up.is_banned THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ban_event_cnt FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick up INNER JOIN public.rta_match_participant mp ON mp.replay_id = up.replay_id AND mp.wizard_id = up.wizard_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM snap) AND mp.season_id = #{seasonId} AND mp.wizard_id = #{wizardId} ) SELECT COALESCE(s.match_cnt, lp.match_cnt, 0) AS match_cnt, COALESCE(s.non_ban_pick_cnt, lpk.non_ban_pick_cnt, 0) AS non_ban_pick_cnt, COALESCE(s.ban_event_cnt, lpk.ban_event_cnt, 0) AS ban_event_cnt, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.match_cnt, lp.match_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND( 100.0 * COALESCE(s.win_cnt, lp.win_cnt, 0)::numeric / COALESCE(s.match_cnt, lp.match_cnt)::numeric, 2 ) END AS season_win_rate_pct, s.computed_at FROM live_part lp CROSS JOIN live_picks lpk LEFT JOIN snap s ON TRUE WHERE COALESCE(s.match_cnt, lp.match_cnt, 0) > 0 LIMIT 1

/* rta-queries-live.listRtaPlayerMonsterPickBucketsFromSnap */ WITH all_slots AS ( SELECT side, slot_no FROM (VALUES (1,1),(1,2),(1,3),(1,4),(1,5), (2,1),(2,2),(2,3),(2,4),(2,5) ) AS s(side, slot_no) ), snap AS ( SELECT s.team_side::int AS team_side, s.pick_slot_no::int AS pick_slot_no, SUM(s.pick_cnt) AS event_cnt, SUM(s.match_cnt) AS field_cnt, SUM(s.win_cnt) AS win_cnt FROM public.rta_agg_summoner_pick_turn_snap s WHERE s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND s.wizard_id = #{wizardId} AND s.unit_master_id = #{unitMasterId} AND s.team_side IS NOT NULL AND s.pick_slot_no BETWEEN 1 AND 5 GROUP BY s.team_side, s.pick_slot_no ), joined AS ( SELECT sl.side::int AS team_side, sl.slot_no::int AS pick_slot_no, COALESCE(a.event_cnt, 0) AS event_cnt, COALESCE(a.field_cnt, 0) AS field_cnt, COALESCE(a.win_cnt, 0) AS win_cnt FROM all_slots sl LEFT JOIN snap a ON a.team_side = sl.side AND a.pick_slot_no = sl.slot_no ), tot_by_side AS ( SELECT j.team_side, COALESCE(SUM(j.event_cnt), 0)::numeric AS total_events FROM joined j GROUP BY j.team_side ) SELECT j.team_side, j.pick_slot_no, j.event_cnt, j.field_cnt, j.win_cnt, CASE WHEN ts.total_events > 0 THEN ROUND((100.0 * j.event_cnt::numeric / ts.total_events)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END AS pick_share_pct, CASE WHEN j.field_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND((100.0 * j.win_cnt::numeric / j.field_cnt::numeric)::numeric, 2) END AS win_rate_pct FROM joined j JOIN tot_by_side ts ON ts.team_side = j.team_side ORDER BY j.team_side ASC, j.pick_slot_no ASC LIMIT 10

/* rta-queries-live.listRtaPlayerOpponentHeadToHead */ SELECT h.opponent_wizard_id, h.opponent_wizard_name, h.opponent_channel_uid, h.opponent_country_code, h.match_cnt, h.win_cnt, h.lose_cnt, CASE WHEN h.match_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND((100.0 * h.win_cnt::numeric / h.match_cnt::numeric), 2) END AS win_rate_pct FROM public.rta_agg_summoner_opponent_h2h_snap h WHERE h.season_id = #{seasonId} AND h.wizard_id = #{wizardId} ORDER BY h.match_cnt DESC, h.opponent_wizard_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

/* rta-queries-live.listRtaSummonerOwnedBoxSnapByWizard */ SELECT b.unit_master_id AS unit_master_id, m.kr_name AS monster_name, m.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental, m.natural_stars AS natural_stars, AS monster_image FROM public.rta_agg_summoner_owned_box_snap b LEFT JOIN public.monster m ON m.monster_id = b.unit_master_id::text WHERE b.wizard_id = #{wizardId} ORDER BY b.unit_master_id ASC LIMIT 10000

/* rta-queries-live.getRtaMonsterOverviewStats */
WITH season_total AS ( SELECT SUM(total_matches) AS field_cnt FROM public.rta_agg_season_rating_match_total WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} AND rating_id > 0 )
SELECT s.unit_master_id, SUM(s.pick_cnt) AS pick_cnt, SUM(s.win_cnt) AS win_cnt, SUM(s.ban_cnt) AS ban_cnt, SUM(s.lead_cnt) AS lead_cnt,
st.field_cnt AS field_cnt, CASE WHEN st.field_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.pick_cnt) / st.field_cnt, 2) END AS pick_rate_pct, CASE WHEN SUM(s.pick_cnt) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.win_cnt) / SUM(s.pick_cnt), 2) END AS win_rate_pct, CASE WHEN st.field_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.ban_cnt) / st.field_cnt, 2) END AS ban_rate_pct, CASE WHEN SUM(s.pick_cnt) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.lead_cnt) / SUM(s.pick_cnt), 2) END AS lead_rate_pct
SUM(s.field_cnt) AS field_cnt, CASE WHEN SUM(s.field_cnt) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.pick_cnt) / SUM(s.field_cnt), 2) END AS pick_rate_pct, CASE WHEN SUM(s.pick_cnt) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.win_cnt) / SUM(s.pick_cnt), 2) END AS win_rate_pct, CASE WHEN SUM(s.field_cnt) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.ban_cnt) / SUM(s.field_cnt), 2) END AS ban_rate_pct, CASE WHEN SUM(s.pick_cnt) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.lead_cnt) / SUM(s.pick_cnt), 2) END AS lead_rate_pct
FROM public.rta_agg_monster_daily_snap s CROSS JOIN season_total st WHERE s.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} AND s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND s.rating_id = #{ratingId} GROUP BY s.unit_master_id , st.field_cnt

/* rta-queries-live.getRtaMonsterOverviewStatsByIds */ SELECT s.unit_master_id, SUM(s.pick_cnt) AS pick_cnt, SUM(s.win_cnt) AS win_cnt, SUM(s.ban_cnt) AS ban_cnt, SUM(s.lead_cnt) AS lead_cnt, SUM(s.field_cnt) AS field_cnt, CASE WHEN SUM(s.field_cnt) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.pick_cnt) / SUM(s.field_cnt), 2) END AS pick_rate_pct, CASE WHEN SUM(s.pick_cnt) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.win_cnt) / SUM(s.pick_cnt), 2) END AS win_rate_pct, CASE WHEN SUM(s.field_cnt) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.ban_cnt) / SUM(s.field_cnt), 2) END AS ban_rate_pct, CASE WHEN SUM(s.pick_cnt) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.lead_cnt) / SUM(s.pick_cnt), 2) END AS lead_rate_pct FROM public.rta_agg_monster_daily_snap s WHERE s.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} AND s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND s.rating_id IN #{rid} GROUP BY s.unit_master_id

/* rta-queries-live.getRtaMonsterDailyTrend */
WITH day_field AS ( SELECT snap_date, SUM(tier_field) AS total_field FROM ( SELECT snap_date, rating_id, MIN(field_cnt) AS tier_field FROM public.rta_agg_monster_daily_snap WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} AND snap_date >= CURRENT_DATE - (#{days} - 1) AND rating_id > 0 GROUP BY snap_date, rating_id ) t GROUP BY snap_date )
SELECT s.snap_date,
SUM(s.pick_cnt) AS pick_cnt, SUM(s.win_cnt) AS win_cnt, SUM(s.ban_cnt) AS ban_cnt, SUM(s.lead_cnt) AS lead_cnt, df.total_field AS field_cnt, CASE WHEN df.total_field > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.pick_cnt) / df.total_field, 2) END AS pick_rate_pct, CASE WHEN SUM(s.pick_cnt) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.win_cnt) / SUM(s.pick_cnt), 2) END AS win_rate_pct, CASE WHEN df.total_field > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.ban_cnt) / df.total_field, 2) END AS ban_rate_pct
s.pick_cnt, s.win_cnt, s.ban_cnt, s.lead_cnt, s.field_cnt, CASE WHEN s.field_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * s.pick_cnt / s.field_cnt, 2) END AS pick_rate_pct, CASE WHEN s.pick_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * s.win_cnt / s.pick_cnt, 2) END AS win_rate_pct, CASE WHEN s.field_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * s.ban_cnt / s.field_cnt, 2) END AS ban_rate_pct
FROM public.rta_agg_monster_daily_snap s JOIN day_field df ON df.snap_date = s.snap_date WHERE s.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} AND s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND s.rating_id = #{ratingId} AND s.snap_date >= CURRENT_DATE - (#{days} - 1) GROUP BY s.snap_date, df.total_field ORDER BY s.snap_date ASC

/* rta-queries-live.getRtaMonsterDailyTrendByIds */ SELECT s.snap_date, SUM(s.pick_cnt) AS pick_cnt, SUM(s.win_cnt) AS win_cnt, SUM(s.ban_cnt) AS ban_cnt, SUM(s.lead_cnt) AS lead_cnt, SUM(s.field_cnt) AS field_cnt, CASE WHEN SUM(s.field_cnt) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.pick_cnt) / SUM(s.field_cnt), 2) END AS pick_rate_pct, CASE WHEN SUM(s.pick_cnt) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.win_cnt) / SUM(s.pick_cnt), 2) END AS win_rate_pct, CASE WHEN SUM(s.field_cnt) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.ban_cnt) / SUM(s.field_cnt), 2) END AS ban_rate_pct FROM public.rta_agg_monster_daily_snap s WHERE s.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} AND s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND s.rating_id IN #{rid} AND s.snap_date >= CURRENT_DATE - (#{days} - 1) GROUP BY s.snap_date ORDER BY s.snap_date ASC

/* rta-queries-live.getRtaMonsterDailyTrendPerRating */ SELECT s.snap_date, s.rating_id, s.pick_cnt, s.win_cnt, s.ban_cnt, s.field_cnt, CASE WHEN s.field_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * s.pick_cnt / s.field_cnt, 2) END AS pick_rate_pct, CASE WHEN s.pick_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * s.win_cnt / s.pick_cnt, 2) END AS win_rate_pct, CASE WHEN s.field_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * s.ban_cnt / s.field_cnt, 2) END AS ban_rate_pct FROM public.rta_agg_monster_daily_snap s WHERE s.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} AND s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND s.rating_id IN #{rid} AND s.snap_date >= CURRENT_DATE - (#{days} - 1) ORDER BY s.snap_date ASC, s.rating_id ASC

/* rta-queries-live.getRtaMonsterPickSlotsByIds */ WITH pick_totals AS ( SELECT ps2.team_side, SUM(ps2.pick_cnt) AS total_pick_cnt FROM public.rta_agg_monster_pick_slot_snap ps2 WHERE ps2.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} AND ps2.season_id = #{seasonId} AND ps2.rating_id IN #{rid} GROUP BY ps2.team_side ), field_totals AS ( SELECT t.team_side, SUM(t.field_cnt) AS total_field_cnt FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (ps2.team_side, ps2.rating_id) ps2.team_side, ps2.field_cnt FROM public.rta_agg_monster_pick_slot_snap ps2 WHERE ps2.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} AND ps2.season_id = #{seasonId} AND ps2.rating_id IN #{rid} ORDER BY ps2.team_side, ps2.rating_id, ps2.pick_slot_no ) t GROUP BY t.team_side ) SELECT ps.team_side, ps.pick_slot_no, SUM(ps.pick_cnt) AS pick_cnt, SUM(ps.win_cnt) AS win_cnt, COALESCE(ft.total_field_cnt, 0) AS field_cnt, CASE WHEN COALESCE(pt.total_pick_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ps.pick_cnt) / pt.total_pick_cnt, 2) END AS pick_share_pct, CASE WHEN SUM(ps.pick_cnt) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ps.win_cnt) / SUM(ps.pick_cnt), 2) END AS win_rate_pct FROM public.rta_agg_monster_pick_slot_snap ps LEFT JOIN pick_totals pt ON pt.team_side = ps.team_side LEFT JOIN field_totals ft ON ft.team_side = ps.team_side WHERE ps.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} AND ps.season_id = #{seasonId} AND ps.rating_id IN #{rid} GROUP BY ps.team_side, ps.pick_slot_no, pt.total_pick_cnt, ft.total_field_cnt ORDER BY ps.team_side, ps.pick_slot_no

/* rta-queries-live.listRtaMonsterTopSummonerSnap */ SELECT wizard_id, wizard_name, channel_uid, ladder_score, rating_id, pick_cnt, ban_cnt, win_cnt, lose_cnt, pick_cnt + ban_cnt AS actual_pick_cnt, win_rate_pct, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ladder_score, 0) >= 3500 THEN true ELSE false END AS above_threshold FROM public.rta_agg_monster_top_summoner_snap WHERE unit_master_id = #{monsterId} AND season_id = #{seasonId} ORDER BY rank_no

/* rta-queries-live.getRtaMonsterTopSummoners */ SELECT s.wizard_id, COALESCE(ss.wizard_name, rs.wizard_name) AS wizard_name, COALESCE(ss.channel_uid, rs.channel_uid) AS channel_uid, rs.score AS ladder_score, rs.rating_id AS rating_id, s.pick_cnt, s.ban_cnt, s.win_cnt, s.lose_cnt, s.pick_cnt + s.ban_cnt AS actual_pick_cnt, CASE WHEN s.win_cnt + s.lose_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * s.win_cnt / (s.win_cnt + s.lose_cnt), 1) END AS win_rate_pct, CASE WHEN COALESCE(rs.score, 0) >= 3500 THEN true ELSE false END AS above_threshold FROM public.rta_agg_summoner_monster_snap s LEFT JOIN public.rta_agg_summoner_search_snap ss ON ss.wizard_id = s.wizard_id LEFT JOIN public.rta_agg_summoner_ranking_snap rs ON rs.wizard_id::text = s.wizard_id AND rs.season_id = s.season_id WHERE s.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} AND s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND s.pick_cnt >= 5 ORDER BY above_threshold DESC, win_rate_pct DESC NULLS LAST, s.pick_cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
